summary: Fixed Git Bash console window appearing when 'Invoke Claude All' is clicked. The issue was that: 1) User had gitbash set as preferred terminal, 2) node-pty was spawning bash.exe without windowsHide option, 3) bash was starting with --login -i flags which opened visible window. Fixed by: 1) Adding windowsHide:true to pty.spawn options, 2) Adding --noprofile --norc flags to bash to prevent login shell, 3) Adding detached mode and proper stdio to where command spawns.
current_status: All shell spawns now include window hiding. Git Bash will spawn with --noprofile --norc to prevent interactive window.
next_steps: User must run: npm run build
Test 'Invoke Claude All' - should work without Git Bash window
If user wants cmd.exe instead of gitbash, they can change in settings
